title: 2 injured in fireworks mishap at Mashpee country club - NewsBreak
text: MASHPEE, Mass. (WPRI) — A professional fireworks display that prematurely exploded at a Mashpee country club sent two workers to the hospital Wednesday afternoon, according to authorities. The Mashpee Fire Department said workers were setting up the annual Fourth of July fireworks display on the New Seabury Country Club golf course when it started exploding. Footage shared with 12 News shows fireworks igniting low to the ground surrounded by a plume of smoke and workers running away from the blasts. One worker was flown to Rhode Island Hospital with serious injuries, according to the fire department, while another was brought to Falmouth Hospital with minor injuries. Six others were also injured but were treated by first responders on site, the fire department said. Pyrotecnico, the pyrotechnics company in charge of the show, said in a statement that their team was assembling the display when a shell ignited and spread to the other cases on the ground. What exactly caused that shell to ignite is now being investigated by the Massachusetts State Fire Marshal. The country club’s fireworks display has since been canceled as a result of the mishap.
